niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, contemporary interfaces with clear hierarchy, restrained clutter, and either airy light-mode calmness or sleek dark-mode seriousness depending on whether the screen still feels intentional, structured, and complete. Consistently favors strong information architecture, integrated components, refined rounded surfaces, and interfaces that feel premium, composed, and editorial rather than generic, procedural, or unfinished.

criteria.description: Prefers a strong top-down reading order with clearly grouped sections, obvious prioritization, and structured progression from headline to content to actions.
Prefers interfaces with fewer competing markers, less decorative clutter, and cleaner surfaces that keep attention on the main task.
Prefers contemporary, polished, editorial-feeling UI with confident visual taste rather than generic enterprise, default-app, or unfinished styling.
Prefers rounded, smoother, gentler cards, panels, and controls over sharper, harsher, or more mechanical component treatment.
Prefers layouts where search, rows, sections, and containers feel visually integrated into one coherent system rather than detached floating blocks or inconsistent treatments.
Prefers screens that feel fully populated, intentionally designed, and structurally complete, with visible grouping and no empty, ambiguous, or placeholder-like areas.
Prefers contrast that feels deliberate and polished—enough to create hierarchy and seriousness, but not harsh, glaring, or visually aggressive.
Prefers obvious actions, concrete task framing, and controls whose purpose is immediately legible, especially when tied directly to items or next steps.
Prefers generous spacing, breathing room, and less cramped composition when it does not make the screen feel empty or underdeveloped.
